decision.explanation: The question asks for the release date of 'The Last of Us Part II'. Source D3S2 explicitly states 'Release Date: June 19, 2020' in the context of 'The Last of Us Part II (PS4)'. Source D1S2 mentions 'June 9, 2010', but this date appears in a document (D1) that also contains the title 'The Last of Us Part II' alongside unrelated text fragments (e.g., 'Playing.', 'Release Date Reveal Trailer'). Given the actual release history of the game (2020) and the explicit pairing of the date 'June 19, 2020' with the title in D3, the 2010 date is likely an error, a hallucination in the source text, or refers to a different entity/context not correctly linked to the specific game title in the provided snippet. The audit J_A and J_B mark C1 (June 9, 2010) as 'wrong_argument' and conflicting with the correct referent. Therefore, only 'June 19, 2020' is the valid answer.
